changes: turn chapter, claim 4, source 4 publisher/supports and caveats: the end was announced 2025-06-24, not 06-23; the 8-K (Items 7.01/8.01) records the termination agreement signed 6/23 and the joint press release issued 6/24, and the Q2 2025 release says 'On June 24, 2025, the Company announced'; claim 4 now also cites source 5, since the press release itself carries no date

origin chapter, claim 1 and source 0 supports: 「準備加強／擬加強」 became 「正在擴充」, as the 2024-03-26 release says Krispy Kreme 'has been scaling' supply chain, support team, equipment and field training; the pilot is no longer called daily delivery (the release says only the national rollout is delivered fresh every day) and is placed 'in the Lexington and Louisville areas'
idea chapter: 「卻沒有任何一份文件拆出…」 became 「這些公告卻都沒有拆出…」, a negative limited to the cited releases
now chapter: the closing 「答案不是沒人買…」 is now attributed to Krispy Kreme's own account (the June release's 'efforts to bring our costs in line with unit demand were unsuccessful')
claim 6: reworded and now also cites source 5, whose key-metrics note says the ~2,400 McDonald's doors were exited in Q3 2025
notes: 終止協議 6/23 簽、聯合新聞稿 6/24 發，不要說 6/23 宣布。逾 1,900 家的日期 2024-12-29 在 Q4 公告店數註腳。Q3 公告正文寫「第三季決定終止」，與 6/24 宣布矛盾，旁白以 6/24 為準。「成本對不上單店需求」是 Krispy Kreme 的說法，麥當勞只說要讓對方也能獲利、合作占其早餐業務很小；試點「需求超預期」也是雙方說法。
